# Bravely Default II Fix
[![Patreon-Button](.github/images/Patreon-Button.png)](https://www.patreon.com/Wintermance) [![ko-fi](.github/images/Kofi-Button.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/W7W01UAI9)

This is an ASI plugin for Bravely Default II that adds support for ultrawide/narrower resolutions, enables the console and more.

## Features
- Skip intro logos.
- Ultrawide/narrower resolution support.
- Enable developer console.

## Installation  
- Download the latest release from [here](../../../releases). 
- Extract the contents of the release zip in to the the game folder. e.g (**steamapps\common\BRAVELY DEFAULT II** for Steam)  

### Steam Deck/Linux Additional Instructions
🚩**You do not need to do this if you are using Windows!**  
- Open the game properties in Steam and add `WINEDLLOVERRIDES="dsound=n,b" %command%` to the launch options.  

## Configuration
- Open **`BravelyDefault2Fix.ini`** to adjust settings.
